cohort: The study included 81,244 pregnant women from the Norwegian Mother and Child Cohort Study (MoBa) after excluding pregnancies with serious health complications.
finding: High levels of trait anxiety were substantially associated with an increased likelihood of both late preterm and early term deliveries.
mod_finding: Women with high anxiety scores showed increased odds for both spontaneous and provider-initiated late preterm and early term deliveries, and women with provider-initiated deliveries generally had higher anxiety levels.
